profile.name: m6000-256g
profile.title: Quadro M6000 24 GB with 192 GB of RAM or more (the reference system)
profile.tested: 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-18 on the reference system: EPYC, 236 GiB of RAM, PCIe Gen3 x16 (docs/FINDINGS.md)
notes: The reference system. A 48 GiB conversation cache keeps 16 parked conversations, so agents that switch between several get their prompts back without re-reading them.

speed.description: Q2_0 pack, 2.4 bits/weight: the fastest; task average 89.1 against the original's 93.1

quality.description: IQ3_S pack, 3.5 bits/weight: task average 93.3, level with the original model

speed-1m.description: speed with a 1,048,576-token context (YaRN x4; slightly changes answers at every length)
